messages:
Oncall Bot: :rotating_light: P1 alert triggered for production /v1/generate - error-rate 18% over 5m, 1766554321. Pager routed to oncall rotation.
Alex P: grabbing driver now. pulling up metrics and recent deploys.
Alex P: quick check — any active rollouts in the last 30m?
Maria G: No deploys from platform in last hour. I saw a Canary job fail earlier but it was unrelated. I can take comms for the first 30m.
Ravi K: I'll be secondary (backup driver) and on-call for infra ops.
Alex P: ack. Maria = comms, Ravi = secondary. Jamie, can you own postmortem and customer comms follow-ups?
Jamie L: Yep, I can own postmortem and coordinate with support SMEs.
SRE Runbook Bot: Recommended runbook: P1 - High error-rate on inference endpoints -> https://confluence.redwood.internal/runbooks/p1-inference-errors (check ingress, model runtime, mem/CPU, restart path).
Alex P: following runbook steps now: 1) check gateway logs (nginx) 2) check model-serving pod error logs 3) check GPU memory pressure and OOMs 4) pull last 30s of traces.
Alex P: running: `kubectl get pods -n inference -l app=inference -o wide` and `kubectl logs -n inference -l app=inference --since=5m`
Alex P: Gateway shows 503 spikes at 12:07-12:09 UTC, model-service pods showing repeated "kv cache miss" errors and some OOMKills on node gpux-02.
Maria G: customer-impact: support dashboard shows ~4% of requests failing to complete (500/avg) — region us-west-2 most affected. Raising a banner to #customers-impact with initial note.
Maria G: drafted message: "We are investigating increased error rates impacting inference requests in us-west-2. Oncall team is actively diagnosing; we'll post updates every 15 minutes." Want approval before post.
Alex P: approved. Post now and add link to this thread.
Maria G: posted. :thumbsup:
Alex P: mitigation options: a) restart pods on gpux-02 to clear OOM state, b) scale up pool by 2 replicas to absorb traffic, c) route traffic away from gpux-02 via weight change. Which do we prefer?
Ravi K: If gpux-02 has OOM problems, let's drain it and restart pods on other nodes. Scaling up might help but could just spread the failure. Recommend (c) + (a) as quick steps: shift traffic away, then restart pods on that node.
Alex P: ok doing (c) now — changing routing weights to reduce traffic to gpux-02: `infractl route modify --pool inference-usw2 --decrease-node gpux-02 --by 30%`
Oncall Bot: Action logged: routing change applied by Alex P at 1766555600. Traffic to gpux-02 decreased by 30%.
Alex P: now initiating rolling restart of inference pods on gpux-02: `kubectl rollout restart deployment/inference-service -n inference --field-selector spec.nodeName=gpux-02`
Alex P: restarting pods — monitoring errors and success rates.
Maria G: next comms update: "We reduced traffic to affected node and are restarting services. Error rates trending down — will confirm in 10m."
Jamie L: tagging support lead @support-lead for any high-touch customers to notify. Also I’ll collect list of affected customers from logs after the incident subsides.
Ravi K: monitoring node metrics — GPU mem pressure drops after restarts, OOM count reset.
Alex P: error-rate dropped from 18% to 3% in 8 minutes. Propagating as mitigation success.
Maria G: posted update to #customers-impact with improvement note and ETA for full recovery 30m.
Alex P: taking driver until handoff at 20:30 UTC. Maria remains comms until 20:00 then hands to Jamie. Ravi will pick up if there’s any recurrence.
Jamie L: noted. I'll schedule the postmortem owner assignment and create a checklist: timeline, root-cause hypotheses (OOMs vs kernel mismatch), mitigation steps taken, follow-ups (node health checks, autoscaler thresholds, runbook update).
Alex P: reminder to update the incident doc with timestamps and commands used (include routing command and restart command).
Maria G: added links and initial timeline to the incident doc.
Oncall Bot: Incident severity remains P1. Next automated reminder in 15m.
Alex P: closing loop for now — all hands keep monitoring. If errors creep above 5% re-escalate and we switch to full failover to a different region.
Maria G: acknowledged. :white_check_mark:
Jamie L: logging action items in the postmortem task list.
Ravi K: standing by.
Oncall Bot: Thread archived in ephemeral retention view at 1766558021."
